x: The 126 starters soon sorted themselves out in three groups of varying speed, and were soon sweating nicely on an oppressively hot day, with Wright and Collins well up and Barry Watson, last year's third man also well to the fore but soon to retire.

The early leaders included International Keith Penny, Olympic Marathoner Barry Watson and our own Laurie O'Hara. Laurie finished within 1½ minutes of Watson in 6th place and won the vets prize by a long way.
Seamus Kerr of Enfield A.C. was a comfortable winner from 400 club runners in the Ranelagh half marathon at Effingham 1 minute ahead of the former Olympic marathon runner Barry Watson.
